articles.summary: Fans can score a dozen Apple Cider Original Glazed Doughnuts for just $5 with the purchase of any dozen at a regular price, Sept. 10-13 Fall flavors are here and football is back – and Krispy Kreme® is making both even sweeter. Beginning Thursday, Sept. 10, fans can enjoy the NEW Apple Cider Original Glazed® Doughnut and a Fall Football Dozen made for game day gatherings, watch parties and all the delicious moments of the season. Fans can score a dozen Apple Cider Original Glazed Doughnuts for just $5 with the purchase of any dozen at a regular price, Sept. 10-13 And there’s an even sweeter reason to huddle up: for four days only, Sept. 10 through 13 , guests can score a dozen Apple Cider Original Glazed® Doughnuts for just $5 with the purchase of any dozen at regular price at participating Krispy Kreme shops.
